{{Quote|I'm Commander Gilad Pellaeon, third bridge officer of the Imperial Star Destroyer ''Chimaera''. Captain Drusan asked me to greet you, and to inform you that he'll pay his own respects as soon as his duties on the bridge permit.|Commander Gilad Pellaeon introduces himself to [[Nuso Esva]]|<ref name="Choices" />}}
'''Third bridge officer''' was a [[Military rank/Legends|military rank]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and its [[Imperial Navy/Legends|navy]]. [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] was the third [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']].<ref name="Choices" />

==Behind the scenes==
The rank of third bridge officer appeared in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[2011]] novel ''[[Choices of One]]''.<ref name="Choices" />
